title: Score (one row of scores.csv)
description: One scored transaction. scores.csv holds one row per input transaction, sorted by `rank`.

payment_type.description: Present only when the input carried it.

score.description: Calibrated probability of laundering. Saturates at 1.0 for the most severe cases; order those by `rank`, not by score.

raw_score.description: Uncalibrated model output. Use it only to break ties among equal scores; `rank` already does.

rank.description: 1 = most suspicious. Orders by score, then raw_score.

alert.description: score >= the package threshold for a 1% alert budget (see run.json).
